stories.title: Plum to Valkyries? Morrow to Tempo? Moves to watch for ahead of WNBA trade deadline
stories.summary: Kelsey Plum, Aneesah Morrow and Betnijah Laney-Hamilton could be on the move before the WNBA trade deadline.

stories.title: Deebo back to 49ers on 1-year deal, sources say
stories.summary: Free agent Deebo Samuel is signing back with the 49ers on a 1-year deal that could be worth up to $7 million, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Ohtani (knee) out vs. M's; Dodgers cite precaution
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani was absent from the Los Angeles Dodgers' lineup on Thursday because of lingering soreness in his left knee.

stories.title: Saints' Olave signs extension worth up to $132M
stories.summary: The Saints are signing wide receiver Chris Olave to a four-year extension worth up to $132 million, including $90 million guaranteed, his agents Drew Rosenhaus and Jason Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
